# .github/workflows/daily_engine.yml
name: Daily Football Value Engine

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * *' # Runs every day at 5:00 AM UTC (6:00 AM WAT)
  workflow_dispatch:      # Allows manual trigger from GitHub anytime

jobs:
  run-engine:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests scipy

      - name: Run Production Model
        env:
          ODDS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ODDS_API_KEY }}
          EMAIL_SENDER: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_SENDER }}
          EMAIL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_PASSWORD }}
          EMAIL_RECEIVER: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_RECEIVER }}
        run: |
          python production_model.py
